title: Wingspan
components: 40 Wooden action cubes (8 in each of 5 colors)
103 Food tokens (Invertebrate, Seed, Fish, Fruit, Rodent)
setup: Each player receives 1 player mat, 8 action cubes of 1 color, 5 bird cards, 2 bonus cards, and 1 of each food token (5 total).
Choose which bird cards to keep (up to 5). For every bird card kept, discard 1 food token (total cards kept + food kept must equal 5).
Choose 1 bonus card to keep and discard the other.
Roll the 5 food dice into the birdfeeder dice tower.
Deal 3 face-up bird cards into the bird tray; place remaining cards as a face-down draw deck.
Place 4 random end-of-round goal tiles onto the goal board (matching the chosen side: green for direct rank, blue for threshold scoring).
procedure: Place 1 action cube on the leftmost exposed slot of one of the 4 rows on your mat:
Action A - Play a Bird: Pay the food cost printed on the bird card plus the egg cost of the column (0, 1, or 2 eggs). Trigger any 'WHEN PLAYED' (white) power.
Action B - Gain Food (Forest): Take food dice shown on the space from the birdfeeder. Then activate all 'WHEN ACTIVATED' (brown) powers in that forest row moving RIGHT to LEFT.
Action C - Lay Eggs (Grasslands): Take eggs shown on the space and place them on birds up to each bird's egg limit. Then activate all brown powers in that grassland row from RIGHT to LEFT.
Action D - Draw Cards (Wetlands): Draw bird cards shown on the space from the tray or deck. Then activate all brown powers in that wetlands row from RIGHT to LEFT.
endGame: Trigger: Game ends immediately after Round 4 (when all 4 end-of-round goals are evaluated).
Bird Cards: Sum the printed Victory Points on all bird cards played on your mat.
Bonus Cards: Score points for all achieved conditions on your kept bonus cards.
End-of-Round Goals: Add points scored on the goal board across all 4 rounds.
Eggs: 1 Victory Point per egg token remaining on bird cards.
Food Cached: 1 Victory Point per food token stored on bird cards.
Cards Tucked: 1 Victory Point per card tucked beneath bird cards.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: The tied player with the most unused food tokens in their personal supply wins. If still tied, victory is shared.
notes: Round Length: The number of turns decreases each round (R1 = 8, R2 = 7, R3 = 6, R4 = 5) because 1 action cube is placed on the goal board at the end of each round.
Birdfeeder Reroll: You may only reroll all dice in the birdfeeder if all dice in the feeder show the exact same face, or if the feeder is completely empty.
Food Conversion: At any time during your turn, you may exchange any 2 food tokens for any 1 food token of your choice.
